long_biography.plain_text:
Facebook's original Harvard network became the foundation of Meta under co-founder Mark Zuckerberg, who remains the technology group's chairman and chief executive. A school-age programmer, he studied computer science at Harvard and left after the network's early expansion to build the company full time.

Zuckerberg continues to set Meta's overall direction and product strategy, supported by the voting control attached to his founder stake. He also co-founded the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, whose Biohub brings scientists, engineers and AI experts together to develop tools for studying cells, disease and basic human biology.
